emergencyTypes.name: Gas smell or gas leak
tips: Turn off the stove knobs and the main gas valve (or the cylinder regulator) if you can reach them safely.
Open all doors and windows to let fresh air in.
Do not turn any electric switch on or off, and do not use a lighter, match or anything with a flame.
Go outside before you make a phone call.
If the smell is strong, leave the home and call 999.

emergencyTypes.name: Sparks or burning smell from an electric point
tips: Switch off the main switch or circuit breaker if you can reach it safely.
Do not touch the socket, wire or appliance.
Never pour water on sparks or an electric fire.
If you see smoke or fire, leave the home and call 999.

emergencyTypes.name: Water near electric wiring, switches or sockets
tips: Switch off the main power only if you can reach the main switch from a dry place.
Do not touch switches, sockets or appliances with wet hands or while standing in water.
Keep children and others away from the wet area.

emergencyTypes.name: Fire or heavy smoke
tips: Leave the home right away and help others leave.
Use the stairs, not the lift.
Do not go back inside to collect belongings.
